description: Get insider (SEC Form 4) transactions for one company. Two grains, and the answer says which: (1) with `executive_cik` -> one row per Form 4 transaction line, with its SEC code (P open-market or private purchase, S open-market or private sale, M/X/C option or RSU exercise/conversion, A grant/award, F shares withheld for tax, G gift, ...), shares, price and value; (2) without it -> one row per insider per trade date that AGGREGATES all that day's lines, split into code P/S purchases/sales (open market or private) versus all acquisitions/dispositions (which also count vests, exercises and tax withholding), with both dollar totals and the line count; when ko.io reports them, the Lines cell and structuredContent also carry that day's SEC codes (e.g. '4 (F 1, M 2, S 1)'). Do not read an aggregate day's total disposed value as a sale decision; use the P/S columns, whose dollar totals cover priced lines only (unpriced lines are counted and flagged as partial). Keyless/Free access covers the trailing 92 days; `period` beyond 1Q requires Pro. structuredContent carries the exact share counts and dollar amounts.

executive_cik.description: Insider's SEC CIK (from a previous answer's person_cik, or list_insider_traders). When given, returns that insider's individual Form 4 transaction lines in this company, newest first.

period.description: Trade-date window for the per-day view: 1Q = trailing 90 days (default, allowed on every plan); 2Q / 1Y / ALL require Pro. Ignored when executive_cik is given (that view returns the full history your plan allows).

name: get_insider_trades

grain.description: insider_trade_date = one row per insider per day, aggregating that day's Form 4 lines; form4_transaction_line = one row per line

paging.description: Paging state reconciled from ko.io meta.total_count and meta.softwall

continuation.description: SIGNIN_REQUIRED = page>1 needs a (free) ko.io API key

has_more.description: null = a full page came back and more MAY exist

next_page.description: Next page THIS caller can open; null when there is none (or sign-in is required)

plan_row_cap.description: Row cap the caller's plan applied to this page, if any

total_count.description: Total rows matching the request, when ko.io reported it

truncated_by_plan.description: True when the plan's row cap withheld rows from this page

plan_limit.description: The Free/keyless plan limits ko.io applied to this answer (null for paid callers)

all_shares_acquired.description: Exact decimal string as served by ko.io (not rounded); null = unknown

all_shares_disposed.description: Exact decimal string as served by ko.io (not rounded); null = unknown

all_value_acquired.description: Exact decimal string as served by ko.io (not rounded); null = unknown

all_value_disposed.description: Exact decimal string as served by ko.io (not rounded); null = unknown

code_p_or_s.description: true for SEC codes P (purchase) and S (sale) -- open market OR private; the code does not distinguish

price.description: Exact decimal string as served by ko.io (not rounded); null = unknown

ps_buy_lines.description: Code P lines that day (open market or private purchases)

ps_buy_unpriced_lines.description: Code P lines with no dollar value; > 0 means ps_value_bought is partial

ps_sell_lines.description: Code S lines that day (open market or private sales)

ps_sell_unpriced_lines.description: Code S lines with no dollar value; > 0 means ps_value_sold is partial

ps_shares_bought.description: null = unknown (a line had no share count)

ps_shares_sold.description: Exact decimal string as served by ko.io (not rounded); null = unknown

ps_value_bought.description: Dollar total of PRICED code P lines only

ps_value_bought_complete.description: false = some code P lines unpriced; null = not reported

ps_value_sold.description: Dollar total of PRICED code S lines only

shares.description: Exact decimal string as served by ko.io (not rounded); null = unknown

transaction_code_breakdown.description: Per code x acquired/disposed x table: line count, shares, value (null = unknown, not partial)

transaction_codes.description: Distinct SEC Form 4 codes aggregated into this day (e.g. ["F","M","S"]); null = not reported by ko.io

value.description: Exact decimal string as served by ko.io (not rounded); null = unknown
